fatura.buyer: The field 'buyer' holds the name or identifier of the person or entity making the purchase.
fatura.date: The 'date' field holds the date when the transaction or event occurred.
fatura.due_date: The 'due_date' field holds the date by which the transaction or service is expected to be completed or paid for.
fatura.number: The field 'number' holds the unique identifier or reference number for the transaction.
fatura.seller_address: The seller's address is recorded in the 'seller_address' field of the document.
fatura.seller_name: The seller's name as provided in the document.
fatura.sub_total: The 'sub_total' field holds the subtotal amount of a transaction.
fatura.title: The field 'title' holds the title of the document being processed.
fatura.total: The field 'total' holds the final amount or sum of all items in the document.
